name: eduverse
description: EDUVERSE — The Learning Adventure: game edukasi 3D multiplayer berbasis web untuk siswa SD

scripts.build: npm run build -w @eduverse/shared && npm run build -w @eduverse/game && npm run build -w @eduverse/dashboard && npm run build -w @eduverse/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @eduverse/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @eduverse/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @eduverse/shared && npm run dev -w @eduverse/server
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @eduverse/shared && npm run build -w @eduverse/game && npm run build -w @eduverse/dashboard -- --outDir ../game/dist/guru --emptyOutDir && node scripts/write-web-config.mjs
